matches.rationale: Both describe the same defect: withdrawEth checks the balance against amountWei + feeWei even though the fee is taken out of amountWei.
Both say deleteWithdrawMessage does not reset withdrawMsgIdProcessed, so a cancelled withdrawal id stays consumed.
No finding covers the mismatch between validWithdrawMessage accepting a zero feeReceiver and Treasury.withdrawEth always paying the fee to it.
Both describe claimWithdrawal breaking checks-effects-interactions by setting startTime to NEVER only after the Treasury call.
No finding mentions unused variables such as Treasury's StorageV1 or the unused role constants.
Both say _authorizeWithdraw does not check withdrawMsgIdProcessed, so the same withdrawId can be reused in a different message.
